title: Protein Structure Prediction: From Evolutionary Constraints to Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.16094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structural biology because protein structure underlies molecular function and provides a basis for mechanistic interpretation. Recent advances in deep learning have transformed the field from multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-driven monomer folding into broader frameworks capable of modeling protein complexes and increasingly heterogeneous molecular systems. Existing reviews have summarized this progress from the perspectives of representative models, application domains, and protein design. Building on these efforts, this review focuses on the methodological evolution of the field itself. It examines recent developments through three closely related dimensions: representations and data, architectures and learning strategies, and confidence and evaluation. translated_title: 蛋白质结构预测：从进化约束到生成建模
translated_abstract: 准确的蛋白质结构预测是结构生物学的基础，因为蛋白质结构是分子功能的基础，并为机制解释提供了依据。近年来，深度学习的进展已将这一领域从基于多序列比对（MSA）的单体折叠，转变为能够建模蛋白质复合物和日益异质的分子系统的更广泛框架。现有综述已从代表性模型、应用领域和蛋白质设计等角度总结了这一进展。在此之上，本综述聚焦于该领域自身的方法论演变。它通过三个紧密相关的维度审视了近期发展：表示与数据、架构与学习策略，以及置信度与评估。在此视角下，该领域被组织为四个方法论阶段和三个交叉转变：从显式进化约束到隐式生成建模。
tldr: 本文综述了蛋白质结构预测领域的方法论演变，提出了四个阶段和三个交叉转变，强调从显式进化约束到隐式生成建模的核心转变。
en_tdlr: This review outlines the methodological evolution of protein structure prediction, proposing four phases and three cross-cutting transitions, highlighting the shift from explicit evolutionary constraints to implicit generative modeling.
